name: mezmo
description: Check Claude Code's Bash and MCP tool calls with Mezmo Governance, send Claude Code telemetry to Mezmo, and connect Claude to Mezmo MCP.

governance_access_key.title: Mezmo Governance service account token
governance_access_key.description: Token of the service account that the Claude Code agent uses in Mezmo Governance, a standard Mezmo service key. Leave empty to keep governance and the ledger off. With a key, every Bash and MCP tool call is checked before it runs and recorded in the Mezmo ledger.

api_url.title: Mezmo API URL
api_url.description: Leave empty for https://api.mezmo.com. Governance uses <API URL>/governance/workflow/authorize and the ledger <API URL>/v1/audit/events.

governance_enabled.title: Check tool calls with Mezmo Governance
governance_enabled.description: Turn off to let tool calls run without a governance check. Governance from managed settings still applies.

ledger_enabled.title: Record tool calls in the Mezmo ledger
ledger_enabled.description: Turn off to stop sending each Bash and MCP tool call to the Mezmo ledger. A ledger URL from managed settings still applies.
